text:
maya: Quick update — PR #50321 is ready for cross-team review. It contains: async request queueing, eviction-threshold tweak, and a small API contract change for canary routing. I want runtime/platform/infra/security review + a canary window booked. Target merge window: Tue 2025-03-04 15:00 UTC (tentative). Pls advise if that conflicts. Link: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/50321 :link:

alex: can you paste a short reviewer checklist here? makes async review easier. :+1:

maya: sure — checklist:
- runtime: correctness of kv spill/fallback path + perf microbench results
- platform: canary routing + rollout policy config (percentages, fallback)
- infra: node/kernel compatibility for new eviction flags
- security: config default & audit logging
- ops: runbook and rollback steps
PR diff: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/50321/files

annie: skimmed the diff — overall looks good. two quick asks:
1) the kv spill threshold constant is now 0.65, can we make it configurable via env var + documented default?
2) please add metric tags for route_version so we can filter canary traffic.
I can take a proper review after those small updates.

olga: infra will check kernel compatibility and the eviction sysctl usage. if the change touches bpf or pinned memory we need a quick validation job. I'll run the node-checker tomorrow morning and report back.

ryan: security notes — config default should remain conservative (off for the API contract toggle). also we need audit events for the rollout decision (who triggered canary, percentages). can you add a short schema change to the audit logs? otherwise quick approval after that.

jin: scheduling note — Tue 15:00 UTC might overlap with a large customer migration window in EMEA. Recommend moving to Wed 03:00 UTC (lower traffic). That also gives infra one more cycle to validate.

sre-oncall: Wed 03:00 UTC works for SRE. we'll reserve the maintenance slot and coordinate on-call coverage. pls add the rollback steps in the runbook: how to revert rollout percentage and how to force-route to previous variant.

maya: thanks — updated plan: Wed 2025-03-05 03:00–05:00 UTC canary. I've pushed two commits: make kv threshold env-configurable + added route_version metric. Also extended runbook with rollback steps.

deploy-bot: /schedule canary PR#50321 2025-03-05T03:00Z 2025-03-05T05:00Z — scheduled by maya. :white_check_mark:

alex: I'll own the merge + gate. my plan: merge to staging, smoke tests 20m, then promote canary 10% -> 50% over 45m if no regressions. I'll post status updates in this thread during rollout.

annie: LGTM after the env var default doc. i've left one inline comment in the PR about the naming of the env var. otherwise ok to approve.

ryan: security — approve after audit event schema commit included. left a small nit in the PR.

olga: infra — OK to proceed, node-checker passed on two test fleets, no kernel issues found.

maya: all changes landed and comments addressed. tagging maintainers: @annie @olga @ryan @alex — please mark APPROVED in the PR when you can so I can queue the merge. thanks! :pray:

alex: marking APPROVED now, will kick off staging merge at T-30m and report.

annie: APPROVED.

ryan: APPROVED (security).

olga: APPROVED (infra).

maya: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post post-mortem notes and perf numbers in #eng-runtime after the canary completes.
